solver_justification: BFS was chosen over CP-SAT for this parameter regime (N<=8 blocks, 2-3 stacks, 0-2 buffers). The bounded state space is empirically <50k states for these parameters; BFS is complete, transparent, and requires no constraint encoding. CP-SAT would be preferred for N>10 or arbitrary non-ordering constraints. The expansion cap (200k) provides a hard deterministic safety valve.
